scope: Disposable native GitHub-hosted fixtures translated to authenticated stock Ubuntu profiles; core installer with no optional Node/Python/database-engine/Redis additions.
candidate_build: Embedded UI first; native Go 1.26.3; CGO_ENABLED=0; exact clean commit/tree, installer and 19 official release assignments; installed and running process digests checked.

caveats: Public bridge downloads and provenance verification differ from local-SHA transport.
Later installs use warm package/download caches on the same fixture.
These end-to-end case timings do not establish a universal speedup.

prior_attempts.disposition: Cancelled after discovery of active PHP repository legacy DB initializer; exact artifacts/manifests retained, no native pass claimed.
Fresh base installers succeeded natively on four profiles; application-seeding fixture used unsupported PUT /settings; full cases failed and are not counted as pass.
One focused AMD64 diagnostic case identified unsupported PUT /settings. Other matrix steps were unselected, not native coverage.

Seven ARM64 cases passed. Both original AMD64 CI profiles correctly withheld root acknowledgements because the hosted image adds unqualified 32-bit loader search paths. Failures retained; no authority was edited.
One AMD64 diagnostic case confirmed unreviewed loader search directories in zz_i386-biarch-compat.conf. Pure diagnostics and journal excerpts retained. Other matrix cases unselected, not coverage.

performance.focus: end-to-end Fluxo installation and update only
performance.comparison_limit: Different hosted machines, network downloads, genuine cron timing, explicit local-SHA base transport and warm caches prevent a controlled bridge-versus-base speedup claim.
avoided_work: historical schema and plaintext conversions on base startup
legacy first-reader conversion on genuinely fresh base
redundant second ordinary compatibility pass; retained only for exact interruption recovery
retained_work: original data/key identity and retained archive validation
genuine scheduling acknowledgements and health checks

limits: Previously user-skipped early-interruption native scenario remains excluded.
Candidate CI artifacts are not final signed immutable public release assets.
No arbitrary custom-provider, live ACME issuance/renewal, remote backup restore, hosted database workload or complete Laravel application acceptance is claimed.
publication: ON HOLD; main/latest and immutable bridge assets unchanged.

production_source_equivalence.later_differences: CI-only diagnostics, selection and stock AMD64 loader preparation. VCS source stamps differ; each executed image has its own exact recorded digest. No production Go/frontend/installer/pin/builder input change.

supported_profile_scope.amd64: Ubuntu 24.04 cron; empty disposable hosted fixture translated to stock reviewed inputs, including archiving only the exact CI multilib search list and refreshing ldconfig; original config restored afterwards. No package/library removed and no production allowlist widened.
supported_profile_scope.arm64: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04 cron, plus Ubuntu 24.04 Cronie bridge path; same established authenticated stock-fixture preparation as bridge trials.

remaining_release_gates: Explicit public version and release-build approval.
